Pay suppliers & collect from buyers
Pakistan's instant payment system (State Bank). Build a bulk payment file to upload to your bank — pay all suppliers at once, free.

Beneficiaries

⇄ DATA MIGRATION CENTER
Bring data in, take data out — easily
Switching from Odoo, QuickBooks, SAP or Excel? Import all your data in minutes. Leaving? Export everything cleanly. No lock-in, no lost data.

Bring Data IN (Import)

Moving from another system? Import your master data step by step. Download the template, fill it (or paste your old system's export), and upload. The system checks for errors before saving.
1. Buyers / Customers
Name, NTN, STRN, phone, address
2. Products / Items
Description, HS code, unit, rate, tax%
3. Opening Balances
Buyer, amount they owe you (receivable)
4. Stock / Inventory
Item, category, quantity, cost

Take Data OUT (Export)

Your data is always yours. Export everything to Excel or a full backup file any time — no lock-in.
Recommended import order: Buyers → Products → Stock → Opening Balances — same as Odoo and SAP.

ERP Settings

Turn ERP modules on or off for this company. Your company's logo and address appear automatically on all ERP documents and reports.
Modules
Documents (upload for admin)
Upload up to 2 admin files (e.g. AI Handover Report, master notes). Stored locally for your reference.
Tax Authority (FBR / SRB / PRA)
Set where you report: FBR (goods) or provincial SRB/PRA (services like restaurants).
Subscription Package
Choose a package — the available modules and features are set automatically based on the plan (like Odoo, Zoho and SAP tiers).
Notifications
Customise automatic messages sent to customers (invoice, reminders, receipts).
Security
Protect your data with login security controls — like SAP, Oracle and NetSuite.
Password hashing, account lockout, session timeout and audit logging are all active.
Backup & Data
Keep your data safe. Download a full backup any time, restore from a backup file, or export everything to Excel.
AI Assistant
The AI assistant is built in. It becomes active once connected to the AI service by your provider.

Invoice Defaults & Automation
Automatic tax rate
When on, the tax rate comes from FBR based on the HS code — only valid rates can be picked, so mistakes are prevented. When off, you type the rate yourself.
Use full FBR tariff
Search the complete FBR HS code list (7,808 codes) instead of the common ones. A code FBR would reject cannot be typed by mistake.
Verify buyer with FBR automatically
When you enter a buyer NTN, check their registration and active/inactive status with FBR right away.
Require buyer NTN
Do not allow an invoice to be saved for a registered buyer without an NTN.
Pre-selected on every new invoice
Pre-filled on every new line
Used when automatic tax rate is off
Pre-filled on every new invoice
Email Settings — send invoices from your own email
Add your email to send invoices directly from the software, under your own address. Opening these settings asks for the administrator password.
Protected — administrator only
Pick your provider to auto-fill the mail server
Invoices will be sent from this address
Stored securely on your server, never shown again
Check your email works before sending invoices
587 (TLS) or 465 (SSL)
Document Designs — logo, colours & layout
Design how your documents look — invoice, quotation, credit note and delivery challan. Set one master design and it applies to all, or customise each document separately. Opening these settings asks for the administrator password.
Protected — administrator only
Quotation Settings
Set the defaults for new quotations. You can still change these on each quotation as you make it. Opening these settings asks for the administrator password.
Protected — administrator only
Include sales tax by default
New quotations include sales tax. You can switch it off on any single quotation.
Used on new quotations — changeable per quotation
Quotation validity — changeable per quotation
Remind you to follow up this many days after sending a quotation. Leave blank for no reminder.
Show my company name on quotations & invoices
Turn off if you prefer not to show your business name on the printed document.
Commercial Invoice
Enable commercial invoice
Print a commercial invoice alongside the sales tax invoice. It uses the same buyer and items — no re-typing.
Both on one file
Print the commercial invoice and the sales tax invoice together as one document.
Hide tax details on commercial invoice
Show only quantity, rate and amount — no tax breakdown — on the commercial copy.
Show HS code on commercial invoice
Include the HS code column on the commercial copy. Turn off to leave it out.
Heading printed on the commercial copy

FBR Digital Invoicing

Your invoices are sent to FBR through a small bridge script that runs in your own Google account. Your FBR security token is stored there, never in this file. Set the bridge up once using the guide, paste its web app URL below, and test the connection.

Before you go live
